sections.text_helper: Section 20.3.4 "Clock/reset manager" in chapter 20 (Neural-ART accelerator™ (NPU)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 1015.
sections.section_content:
The purpose of this unit is twofold:
1. Clock control
The NPU uses a single functional clock provided by the RCC. This input clock is fed to
the clock control unit from where it is gated and fed to the different units of the IP.
The clock unit generates clocks not gated, and clocks gated by default that need to be
enabled after reset.
Clock gating is controlled by a configuration register bank, accessible via the
configuration network, and programmed by the control code generated by the NPU
compiler tool chain.
2. Reset control
The NPU uses a single functional reset provided by the RCC. This reset signal is
synchronized inside the IP and fed to the different functional units.
Setting the clear bit in the control configuration register triggers a global NPU reset.
